Problem Statement:
A number is given as input(as string). Find the maximum length of substring alternating digits of odd and even.
input_spec:
(as string). Find the maximum length of substring alternating digits of odd and even.

Input Description:
The input is a number given as a string. The input size N is less than or equal to 10000000000.
output_spec: The output is the maximum length of a substring with alternating odd and even digits.
